Mary De Morgan, The Windfairies.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/mary-de-morgan/the-windfairies

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Mary De Morgan, the author, died 1907.

First publication of the text used: 1900 (SE colophon: 'The Windfairies was published in 1900 by Mary De Morgan.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1900, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so it entered by 1995.
- Country of origin (every country): every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last to die did so in 1907.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
